ideas.pitch: An edge-deployable acoustic signal processing platform that detects mechanical anomalies in rotating machinery using streaming FFT and lightweight neural networks, tailored for IEEE Signal Processing Society judges.
ideas.title: SignalSentry: Real-Time Audio Anomaly Detection for Industrial Machinery
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at the IEEE Signal Processing Society context of the hackathon, appealing to judges with deep signal processing backgrounds by focusing on raw frequency-domain analysis rather than generic UI wrappers.

ideas.pitch: A robust 1D convolutional neural network pipeline that extracts QRS complex features from raw ECG sensor streams for continuous biometric user authentication.
ideas.title: BioSignal-Verify: Electrocardiogram Biometric Authentication Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering in biomedical signal processing, which immediately stands out to IEEE SPS judges looking for rigorous mathematical and algorithmic applications.

ideas.pitch: A digital signal processing web utility that applies adaptive filter algorithms and wavelet packet decomposition to clean up degraded radio and voice transmissions in real-time.
ideas.title: ClearComm: Adaptive Subband Noise Suppression for Emergency Dispatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines clear societal impact with classic DSP textbook concepts implemented in a modern web interface, making it universally understandable and deeply technical.

ideas.pitch: A spectrum analysis dashboard that processes IQ data samples to classify wireless communication modulations and detect narrow-band RF interference sources.
ideas.title: SpectrumScope: RF Signal Classification and Interference Finder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses core wireless communication and telemetry themes dear to IEEE chapters, leveraging concrete mathematical modeling and visualization.

ideas.pitch: A rapid prototyping tool for acoustic engineers that computes and simulates room impulse responses (RIR) using the image source method for virtual acoustics.
ideas.title: EchoSpatial: Binaural Audio Room Impulse Response Synthesizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a niche computational problem with immediate visual gratification during judging demos, hitting the sweet spot of algorithmic complexity and 10-hour hackathon feasibility.
